documents.title: Unilever Industrial Placement Programme - Supply Chain - Technical UK
documents.body:
Our Unilever Industrial Placement (IP) Programme is designed for students who are completing a year in industry as part of their degree studies.

In the UK, our IP programme is a 12-month development scheme, for which we recruit top-performing undergraduate talent, with fresh ideas who are eager to gain exposure to real-world challenges.

All new joiners are given real responsibility from day one and have an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the business. Alongside this, they receive one-to-one mentoring and support to aid their development and help them achieve their goals. These programmes provide a variety of experiences, enabling individuals to learn, grow, develop personally and professionally, build confidence and gain a comprehensive understanding of the business.

About Unilever

Unilever is one of the world's leading FMCG companies, home to iconic brands including Dove, Vaseline, TRESemmé, Lynx, Persil, Domestos, Surf, Radox, Sure and Liquid I.V. Through products used by millions of people every day, we help improve health, wellbeing, confidence and care around the world.

Established over 100 years ago, Unilever has a proud heritage of innovation and a long-standing belief that great brands, great people and responsible business go hand in hand.

Today, we are transforming into a faster, more focused growth company centred on Beauty & Wellbeing, Personal Care and Home Care. Through world-class brands, cutting-edge science and technology, digital innovation and AI-enabled capabilities, we are building unmissably superior products and experiences for consumers around the world.

A career at Unilever offers the opportunity to work at global scale while helping shape the future of some of the world's most recognised brands. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, bringing curiosity, creativity and passion to solve real business challenges and make a meaningful impact every day.

*As we receive a high volume of applications, please make sure to read the job descriptions on our website carefully and apply for the ONE function you are most interested in. Only your first application will be considered*  

What do we look for?

For our Technical roles, we are looking for students studying a STEM discipline. For our Non-Technical  roles, we are open to students from any background who have an appetite for Supply Chain. Students must have completed the penultimate year of their undergraduate degree by the time they start their placement and be returning to study after their placement.

With a strong performance culture, challenging goals, and continuous feedback, we will support you to achieve your potential in an inclusive environment. You will thrive by gaining exposure to real business challenges where your energy and fresh thinking will have an impact. First-hand experience- it’s the fastest way to learn. 

Our Supply Chain Management Industrial Placements are a chance to showcase your ambition, thinking, and skills, with total support from a line manager and a buddy. 

Most of our roles are based at our Port Sunlight, Leeds, Burton and Kingston sites, and applicants must be able to relocate to any of our UK locations.  

Some of our positions you could be allocated to include:  

  • Supply Chain Technical
  • Process Engineer at our Leeds or Port Sunlight factories, working to eliminate defects, losses, and waste, and increase the stability of our production lines.  
  • Process Engineering role in a fast-paced factory, supporting initiatives including LPG tank inspections, Faberge Silverson upgrades, Raw Material Tote Stations as well as support process changes linked to the launch of All Over Body Spray and Neutral Roll-On. This position offers a dynamic opportunity to influence operational efficiency, enhance safety standards, and support innovation. 
  • Contribute to projects focused on improving operational efficiency, sustainability, and technology adoption. Responsibilities may include data collection and analysis, process improvement support, and assisting in the development of digital tools and resources. This role offers exposure to real-world challenges, cross-functional collaboration, and innovation. 

Please note that Technical roles are available for students studying STEM disciplines only. 

What could your day-to-day role include (subjective to your role)?

Supply Chain is Unilever’s biggest function so there is a huge range of opportunities you could take on! Some of these include: 

  • Helping launch the newest Beauty and Personal Care innovation. 
  • Helping to deliver sustainable engineering projects at one of our UK factories.  
  • Working in our UK/head office, ensuring our products arrive on time and in full at our customers! 

Skills required include: 

  • Data analytics & data-driven decision making 
  • Strong problem-solving ability 
  • Proactivity 
  • Effective communication & business partnering 
  • Stakeholder management 
  • Microsoft Office skills (Excel, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint)

Please note, that at Unilever, we have development programmes, the skills above are skills that would be good to have at the beginning however you will develop them over the course of the 12 months. 

Programme details:

Location: 

Technical – You will be based in Port Sunlight or Leeds factories with factory shift patterns of 5 days a week. 

Applications open:  

Monday 14 September 2026 

Applications close:  

This is a rolling deadline, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible to avoid disappointment in case applications close early.

Start date: 

June 2027 

Industrial Placement (IP) Application Process 

Please note: You will only progress to the next stage if you are successful in the previous stage. 

Stage 1 – Online Application & IP Simulation 

Complete an online application form before completing our interactive IP simulation, designed to give you insight into our organisation and the programme you’re applying for. This will prepare you for a series of situational judgement questions based on realistic business scenarios. 

Stage 2 – Online Assessments

Complete a numerical reasoning assessment, an online test that measures your ability to interpret and draw conclusions from numerical data and verbal Reasoning assessment an online test that measures your ability to understand and evaluate written information.  

Stage 3 – Digital Interview

Complete a video interview.

*Please note, we do not use AI as a screening tool in our recruitment process therefore, your digital interview submission will be reviewed by a real person*

Stage 4 – Pre-Screening Interview

Attend a virtual pre-screening interview with a member of our recruitment team.

Stage 5 – In-Person Discovery Centre

Attend an in-person discovery centre alongside fellow candidates. This will give you the opportunity to visit a Unilever office, meet and interview with business leaders, and work on function-related business challenges.

What Can Unilever offer YOU?   

  • A competitive Salary of £27,898.00   
  • End of Placement Bonus   
  • Subsidised Gym Memberships - availability varies by site 
  • Discounted Staff Shop  
  • Opportunity to work directly with our renowned and exciting brands in a flexible and hybrid working environment.   
  • 28 days (pro rata) of holiday inclusive of bank holidays. Once you have completed 12 worked weeks, under the Agency Workers Regulation your holiday entitlement will increase to 33 days inclusive of bank holidays, pro rata for the term of this placement.    
  • Opportunity to join one of our Future Careers Development Teams such as Outreach, Digi, Community & Wellbeing and many more! By joining a team, you can grow business-critical skills, develop Unilever Behaviours, and make a meaningful contribution to Future Careers. 
  • A dedicated buddy to help you onboard and learn about the business.  
  • An experienced Line Manager to develop your knowledge and understanding across the year.

documents.title: Continuous Improvement Placement Programme
documents.body:
At TJX Europe, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritises your development. Whether you’re working in our Distribution Centers, Corporate Offices, or Retail Stores—TK Maxx & Homesense, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX team—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off-price retailer.

Job Description:

Please only apply to this role if you are studying on a course that requires you to undertake an industrial placement for 12 months

About the Program

Continuous improvement is a business strategy that involves the evaluation and revision of processes, methods and practices. The goal of continuous improvement is to make periodic changes to increase the efficiency, accuracy and effectiveness of business operations using key tools from Lean Six Sigma.

What You’ll Do

As a 12 month placement, your main responsibilities will include:

  • You’ll be participating in process improvement projects, leveraging Lean Six Sigma (LSS) methodology, including scoping, defining, prioritizing projects, identifying project metrics, developing control plans to ensure project delivers gains that are continuous and sustainable with results that are measurable and validated developing pilot plans as needed.
  • You’ll be responsible for supporting research that identifies improvement opportunities, including identifying, testing, and developing and implementing sustainable improvement strategies to improve productivity and efficiencies that supports current and future business needs.
  • You’ll provide planning support using DMAIC (Define, Measure, Analyse, Improve, Control) project roadmap includes identifying project metrics, providing methods to validate project solutions, deliver measurable and validated results and develop control plans to ensure project gains are continuous and sustainable.
  • Serving as an internal consultant on assigned projects to assist with identifying improvement opportunities and providing recommendations that includes defining Voice of the Customer, overseeing data collection, analysis, testing.
  • Collaborating with TJX Europe departments where there is impact to operational efficiencies, analysing data based on metrics, providing quantitative and qualitative observations, and developing recommendations based on findings.
  • There is the opportunity to gain Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt qualification. Working as part of a global team, with the opportunity to collaborate and network across international and cross-functional teams

What We’re Looking For

  • Working towards Bachelor’s degree in Business Management/ Engineering/Science (preferred, not essential)
  • Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma (LSS) and DMAIC methodology; LSS Green and/or Yellow belt training an asset
  • Demonstrated project management skills including structured project methodologies (i.e. determining needs, researching existing programs, etc.); utilizing multiple sources of information to develop well-structured business recommendations preparing and maintaining detailed development plans for projects; determining project specifications; understanding and applying principles of project control; and knowledge of and ability to use project reporting systems
  • Good analytical and critical thinking skills to provide solutions; ability to leverage prior experience and adapt quickly to the changing work environment to make effective decisions, revise business strategies to support the vision of the organization
  • Demonstrated problem solving skills including analysis of information (i.e. requirements; description of problems.); provide solutions with cost implications to effectively resolve issues and execute strategic solutions
  • Good organizational development skills including change management, time management; ability to implement and manage details, prioritize, multi-task and sometimes work under time pressure; ability to work independently with minimal supervision
  • Excellent presentation, interpersonal and communication skills; ability to read, write and interpret information accurately.
  • Ability to develop and build relationships with internal and external partners, influence team members and help prioritize activities and resources to meet the organization’s needs; build rapport and credibility to be a trusted advisor
  • Demonstrated people management skills including coaching, providing advice and guidance to Associates to resolve issues/problems, evaluating performance and providing feedback to team members.
  • Good understanding of financial planning, business tools and reports to make business recommendations

Skills/Knowledge

  • Strong computer skills including Ms Office – Word, Excel and PowerPoint Knowledge/experience of PowerBI and Visio would also be an asset
  • PowerPoint, Access; VBA and SharePoint knowledge/experience an asset.
  • Ability to analyze, interpret and present data, Using datasets, charts and tables to communicate findings in a digestible form
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver measurable results
  • Problem solving ability- Lean or Six Sigma
  • Interact and partner with all levels of the organization
  • Project Management

What we offer

At TJX Europe, we believe in supporting our associates to thrive both professionally and personally. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Generous holiday allowance plus bank holidays
  • Exclusive employee discounts at TK Maxx and Homesense
  • Ongoing learning and development opportunities
  • A collaborative, inclusive culture where your voice is valued
  • Access to wellbeing support and resources
  • Pension and life assurance schemes
  • Opportunities to grow your career across our global business
  • Hybrid working model with flexibility
  • A vibrant, campus-style head office in the heart of Watford—featuring a subsidised canteen, onsite gym, free parking, and just a short walk from Watford Junction Station

Application Process

Online application > Psychometric Online Tests > Online Video Interview > Assessment Centre or In Person Interview

You must have the legal right to work in the country you are applying to.

As proud as we are of our past success, it’s our future that excites us most. We strive to provide opportunities for growth, recognition and a competitive salary and benefits package. Share our determination to think bolder and bigger, and be part of our future. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnerships, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and/or sexual orientation.

Address:

73 Clarendon Road

Location:

EUR Home Office Watford GB

documents.title: Film, TV and Disney+ Marketing Internship
documents.body:
Ready to make magic? We’re hiring for our 12-month undergraduate placement schemes.

This dynamic 12-month placement for undergraduate students offers a unique opportunity to dive into the marketing strategies and operations behind the world’s leading entertainment company. Gain hands-on experience and be part of the teams that bring Disney’s magic to audiences across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA).

By undertaking a placement year in Disney Entertainment EMEA, you will contribute to marketing campaigns across iconic brands within Disney Studios (Walt Disney Animation, Pixar, Marvel Studios, Lucasfilm, 20th Century Studios and Searchlight Pictures) or Disney General Entertainment which includes TV brands such as ABC Entertainment, Disney Branded Television, National Geographic and the Disney+ streaming platform.

You’ll join a team grounded in our Disney values; acting with Integrity, welcoming everyone through Inclusion, embracing boundless Creativity, working together through Collaboration and caring deeply for our Community. These values shape how we work and how we support one another every day.

By applying for this opportunity, you will be considered for all available roles outlined below. If you have any role preference(s), please note this in your cover letter.

Content Sales

You will join the team who manage the distribution of Disney media content across TV networks in the EMEA region. You'll help support marketing efforts with pitch decks, campaign analysis, asset delivery, lead internal newsletters, and stay on top of TV industry trends.

Disney+

  • Marketing: You will support the development and delivery of data-led, innovative marketing campaigns across EMEA to help drive awareness for our brand, general entertainment shows, and overall business growth. Key responsibilities include creative asset management, budget tracking, coordinating meetings, preparing presentations, and building relationships with external agencies and partners as well as internal teams such as PR, Social, Finance & Research. Roles in this remit will be across EMEA content marketing, EMEA brand marketing, UK marketing, and partnerships.
  • Growth Marketing (Retention): You will support customer sign-ups and retention by coordinating internal projects, managing campaign assets with tools like Canva and Photoshop, and collaborating cross-functionally to execute marketing campaigns for Disney+ content.
  • Growth Marketing (Acquisition): You will be coordinating with partners and agencies, managing creative assets for campaigns, especially across the Connected TV (CTV) space. Key responsibilities include project management, liaising with partners, analysing performance data, liaise with EMEA markets and overseeing CTV editorial content.

Studios

  • Creative Services: This creative role helps to deliver EMEA campaigns for all Studios brands. You’ll gain experience in strategic media planning, work with agencies on “Out of Home” (OOH) advertising like print, radio, and billboards, and support publicity events such as premieres, junkets, and expos.
  • Digital Marketing: You will support the creation of digital and social content to generate buzz for new Studios releases. You will support logistics, planning and budgeting for content creation, gaining exposure to influencer and digital marketing.
  • Digital Marketing, Measurement & Analytics: Be part of the EMEA team that is driving innovation in the digital marketing space. Supporting on global social & advertising partnerships, collaborate with influencer teams on content creator measurement, and use platform analytics and AI to develop wider digital media measurement and visual solutions, to ultimately turn data into actionable insights with proven ROI.
  • Paid Media: Ideal for someone analytical who communicates well across functions, you will support the team managing Studios’ media budgets across EMEA. You’ll collaborate with media agencies and internal teams to coordinate paid advertising, and work with finance, research, PR, and creative teams.
  • Partnerships: You will support the planning and execution of strategic marketing partnerships for new Studios releases, contributing to creative ideation. You will help identify, secure, and manage promotional partnerships, while supporting the creative execution, approvals process, and delivery of integrated marketing campaigns across a range of channels.
  • Brand Marketing: You will support the UK marketing team across theatrical, electronic home video (EHV), and streaming lifecycle campaigns for all Studios brands (Disney Animation & Live Action, Pixar, Marvel Studios, Lucasfilm, 20th Century Studios & Searchlight Pictures).

Working within any of these teams will provide you with a brilliant foundation in Marketing as well as insight into the world-class Disney Entertainment business.

This is an office-based internship. 4 days working in the Hammersmith, London office with 1 day working from home (Monday or Friday).

Eligibility

  • Important: Please upload your CV and cover letter as a single document, as only one file can be submitted. Applications without a cover letter will not be considered.
  • Must be a second-year undergraduate student on a placement year course returning to study in Autumn 2028
  • Must have the right to work in the UK already in place
  • Available to start working full time from June 2027
  • Interested in the area you are applying for, whether this is through your studies, experiences, extracurricular activities or a general interest

About you

  • A strong interest in the media, content and streaming, and a desire to start your career in this industry
  • Proactive and highly motivated team player, with positive ‘can do’ attitude.
  • Highly organised with strong attention to detail and ability to work well under pressure.
  • Ability to connect with people at all levels in a professional and mature manner.
  • Ability to prioritise tasks, meet deadlines and undertake various administrative duties.
  • Strong MS Office skills, Canva experience desirable
  • Strong desire to get involved, learn and grow to embrace and make the most of this opportunity.

The Perks

  • Develop your workplace skills and experience to help build the foundations of your future career
  • Constructive on-the-job training as well as companywide learning and development initiatives
  • Learn how decisions and actions are made within a global business environment
  • Tackle real responsibility and become an essential part of an encouraging team
  • Have the support and network of a large community of interns
  • Access to join and support our Employee Resource Groups ranging from WOMEN @ Disney, Disney MOSAIC, Disney PRIDE, our disability & neurodiversity focused group - ENABLED, and our Mental Health & Wellbeing Group – TRUST
  • Annual salary of £28,000 with 25 days’ holiday (plus bank holidays)
  • Contractually enrolled into Disney’s workplace pension scheme
  • Discounts & Perks: You are entitled to discounts on designated Disney products, resort food & beverage and ticketing
  • Access to free support services including Unmind, the mental wellbeing app
  • Opportunity to select eye care and flu vouchers

You will need to apply with your CV and cover letter via the link on this page. Please combine your CV and cover letter into one file and upload it when prompted to submit your resume. Please note, applications without a cover letter will not be considered.

For your cover letter we will be looking for approximately 400 words and looking to understand the following areas:

  • Why have you chosen Disney?
  • Why have you chosen this internship?
  • Why should Disney consider you for this internship?

Please only apply for one Internship across The Walt Disney Company. By applying for this opportunity, you may be considered for other roles that align with your interests and skillset.

Once we have received your application, we will be in contact within 14 days to let you know more about the blended online assessment.

The Walt Disney Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strive to be a diverse workforce that is representative of our audiences, and where all can thrive and belong. Disney is committed to forming a team that includes and respects a variety of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided the necessary accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive all benefits of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
